span.label: prospective-observational-survey

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the instrument is built in three declared steps - item development, focus groups, and expert review - used to develop AND refine the items rather than only to produce them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the focus groups use a modified retrospective think-aloud protocol, whose stated purpose is to understand how members of the target population INTERPRET and respond to the items
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the refinement has a STOPPING RULE rather than a fixed number of rounds: transcripts are coded by constant comparison for places where a participant raised concern with an item, and the cycle repeats after each group until no new suggestions emerge
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: latent variable regression is chosen over multiple regression for a stated reason: multiple regression assumes the variables are measured without error, and the authors say that assumption would produce biased estimates here
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the chi-square test is deliberately not relied on alone, because a non-significant chi-square is called unrealistic, so supplementary indices are examined too - with separate numerical bands DESIGNATED for good fit and for excellent fit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: discriminant validity is given a numerical criterion rather than an impression: the average variance extracted for a construct must exceed the SQUARED CORRELATION between it and any other construct, alongside stated floors for loadings and composite reliability
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: relative importance among predictors is decided by an index with a cut-off DERIVED from the number of predictors rather than chosen - one over twice the predictor count, which in this analysis makes the threshold 0.13
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE KEY TEST IS BUILT AS A COMPETING MODEL, NOT A CORRELATION: a three-factor structure is fitted specifically to see whether the new construct is empirically synonymous with one of the three established needs, and the authors state in advance what result would count against their own claim
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The design is non-experimental, so no causal inference is licensed; experiments are needed.
span.note: what this limits: any causal reading: EXPERIMENTAL DESIGNS WILL BE NECESSARY IN FUTURE RESEARCH TO EXAMINE THE EXTENT TO WHICH CHANGES ... RELATE[] TO CHANGES IN EXERCIS[e]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Variety was assessed only at the contextual level.
span.note: what this limits: the level at which the finding holds: assessments of perceived variety were operationalised AT THE CONTEXTUAL LEVEL only
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The results say nothing about acute/episodic effects of perceived variety or about global life-level effects.
span.note: what this limits: acute and global claims: THE RESULTS OF THE STUDY DO NOT PROV[ide evidence] about episodic effects or life-level outcomes
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The factor structure was verified on the same sample used to derive it, only at a different time point.
span.note: what this limits: the factor structure itself: THE USE OF THE SAME SAMPLE TO VERIFY THE FACTOR STRUCTURE (ALBEIT AT DIFFERENT TIME POINTS) AND RESULTS SHOULD BE INTERPRETED WITH CAUTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Whether the new construct is distinct from the three established needs, or subsumed by them, was an open question this study set out to examine rather than assume.
span.note: what this limits: perceived variety as an established separate need: the paper examines whether it is distinct from or subsumed by competence, relatedness and autonomy
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The construct it is measured alongside has been operationalised inconsistently in the literature, sometimes as a single latent variable.
span.note: what this limits: comparisons with other needs-satisfaction studies: the paper notes the construct has at times been operationalised as a single latent variable, and tests a one-factor model for that reason
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the trimmed item pool was reviewed by three people with expertise in instrument development and in the exercise domain
span.note: eliminates: that the items measure something other than the construct they are named for - expert content review is the check on that before any data is collected
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: variety - the general stipulated definition: the pursuit and experience of diverse activities, behaviours and opportunities in one's social milieu
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: variety - the narrower sense used in this study, which explicitly admits simple, mundane and conventional experiences and so is not sensation-seeking
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `felt variety` / `variety support` - TWO TERMS COINED IN ONE SENTENCE TO PREVENT A CONFLATION, WITH THE REASON STATED. `FOR THE SAKE OF CONCEPTUAL CLARITY Quotation withheld` **The pre-existing literature had one word, `variety`, doing both jobs** - an experience and an affordance - and the split is announced as a methodological requirement rather than discovered. The paper then measures only the first.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `competence` / `relatedness` / `autonomy` - THREE NEEDS DEFINED BY A SINGLE `refers to` EACH, AND ALL THREE ARE ATTRIBUTED. Every definition ends in a citation to Deci & Ryan; **the paper is importing a vocabulary intact rather than building one**, which is the opposite move to `felt variety` two pages earlier. The same article both borrows a settled partition and coins a new one, and the writing does not mark the difference.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Perceived variety together with competence, relatedness and autonomy measured at Time 1 explained 37.2% of the variance in exercise-related positive affect six weeks later.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The same four predictors explained 33.1% of the variance in exercise-related subjective vitality.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: For exercise-related negative affect, autonomy was the only statistically significant predictor; perceived variety did not predict it.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A four-factor structure that keeps perceived variety separate from competence, relatedness and autonomy fitted the data better than one-factor or three-factor structures.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: None of the five perceived-variety items cross-loaded onto the competence, relatedness or autonomy subscales at the |0.30| threshold.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Perceived variety in exercise is empirically distinct from, and not subsumed by, perceived competence, relatedness and autonomy.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A supplementary test found no significant curvilinear relationship between perceived variety and positive affect, negative affect or subjective vitality.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors state that the observational design prevents any causal claim about variety and well-being.
